# Lesson build queue

Every lesson in this file is a **coming-soon placeholder** already seeded in the
database by the program migrations (`worker/migrations` 0012-0041). Building a
lesson means replacing that placeholder row's `data` with a full lesson via
`UPDATE lessons SET data = json_patch(data, '{...}') WHERE seed_key = '...'`,
and setting `coming_soon` to `null` so it is removed.

This queue is generated from the migrations themselves, so it is the complete
and current backlog. Regenerate it if a program migration changes.

## Snapshot

- **Coming-soon placeholders in the queue: 19,198**
- Lessons already built (removed from the queue):
  - `s2-eng-y3-w01-l1` - Year 3, Week 1, Lesson 1: Reading with expression
  - `s2-eng-y3-w01-l2` - Year 3, Week 1, Lesson 2: Writing a clear sentence (rebuilt in this batch)
- Two older demo seed lessons (`s2-maths-place-value-01`, `s2-english-persuasive-writing-01`) are not part of the program and are not in this queue.

### Seed-key format

Seed keys are stage, subject, year/syllabus-year, week and lesson, for example
`s2-eng-y3-w01-l2`. Early Stage 1 uses `-k-` for Kindergarten (for example
`es1-eng-k-w01-l1`). Always match the real `seed_key` from this file - never assume it.

### Migration numbering (checked)

There are **two files numbered 0013** in `worker/migrations/`:
`0013_s2_y3_w01_l1_reading_expression.sql` and `0013_s3_maths_program.sql`.
This is a pre-existing duplicate number; it is left untouched (the Lesson 1 file
contains a warning to rename it before applying). The highest number in use is
`0042`, so the **next free migration number is `0043`**. New lesson migrations must
use a fresh number and never renumber existing files.

### Outcome codes

Only the Stage 2 programs (English, Mathematics, Science and Technology, HSIE,
PDHPE, Creative Arts) currently pre-assign NESA outcome codes. Every other stage
(Early Stage 1, Stage 1, Stage 3, Stage 4, Stage 5, Stage 6) has an empty
`outcome_codes` array with a `source_note` saying the codes must be mapped against
the current NESA syllabus at build time. **Do not reuse the placeholder codes blindly**
- check each against the current NESA syllabus for that subject and stage when the
lesson is built.

## Proposed build order (for approval)

The prompt fixes the start: Stage 2 English, Year 3 then Year 4, week by week.
After English, this is the order I propose. Adjust it as you like - the
inventory below is complete regardless, and the order is what I will follow.

- **Phase 1:** Stage 2 English - Year 3, then Year 4 (weeks 1-40, lessons 1-4) - 318 lessons
- **Phase 2:** Stage 2 other subjects - Year 3 then Year 4 (Mathematics, Science and Technology, HSIE, PDHPE, Creative Arts) - 960 lessons
- **Phase 3:** Stage 3 - Years 5-6 (English, Mathematics, Science and Technology, HSIE, PDHPE, Creative Arts) - 1,280 lessons
- **Phase 4:** Stage 1 - Years 1-2 (English, Mathematics, Science and Technology, HSIE, PDHPE, Creative Arts) - 1,280 lessons
- **Phase 5:** Early Stage 1 - Kindergarten (English, Mathematics, Science and Technology, HSIE, PDHPE, Creative Arts) - 640 lessons
- **Phase 6:** Stage 4 core - Year 7-8 (English, Mathematics, Science, HSIE History/Geography, PDHPE, Creative Arts, Technology) - 2,020 lessons
- **Phase 7:** Stage 4 elective and VET-style courses - Year 7-8 - 1,600 lessons
- **Phase 8:** Stage 5 - Years 9-10 (all listed courses) - 3,420 lessons
- **Phase 9:** Stage 6 - Years 11-12 (all listed courses) - 7,680 lessons
